decision: 已实际阅读最终PLAN及输入metadata/几何摘要，批准按具体矩阵实现、冻结source/protocol并在必要改动验证通过后立即运行。无需等待新的用户许可或把准备文档当交付。协调代码审阅可与实现/必要检查并行；发现公共算子或边界错误须纠正并保留痕迹。

scientific_matrix.initialization: D8 strong FT+Ccap lambda0.01, same per-seed B/b
scientific_matrix.first_four_windows: fixed P_FT* retained in full-Hann boundary contribution
scientific_matrix.primary: F minus W, original VAL 60-second person-macro r
scientific_matrix.secondary: Each versus D8 Ccap; fused/weighted/window MSE, disagreement and 3-second r

solver.preconditioner: same deterministic rule, per-objective B diagonal and exact free bias 1x1/2x2 blocks, no target/VAL selection
solver.nonconvergence: Finite fixed-cap solutions are scored once and disclosed, no VAL-dependent budget extension. Only both converged permits optimized-objective comparison.

review_findings: 公共物理点、目标、端点和首4窗上下文定义清楚。W/F正则相同；D8到D9支持不同，不能宣称D8与W只是无影响的loss缩放。
F移除了逐窗加权loss内含的disagreement项；不能预设F会降低disagreement或提高r。
输出列只按j与j+96相耦合。首可学习边界和尾部单窗支持可识别有效bias；仅内部区间的nullspace不能推广到完整记录。
几何bias条件数严重不良已披露，精确小块预条件为目标独立的数值处理。实际真残差、数值有限性及cap必须报告。
本轮没有新增历史推理输入；即使阳性，也只是当前读出监督目标证据，不是连续记忆或论文创新证明。
necessary_changed_path_checks: Synthetic W/F operator, gradient/symmetry, PCG versus direct small solve, exact fixed endpoints; preserve observed results.
Three seeds original first/last VAL records reconstruct D8 initial Ccap with frozen tolerances.
Actual TRAIN duplicated-label consistency, common point/counts and bias geometry match before formal solves.
Source/protocol pins and actual resource ceilings; no new NPY, no EEG encoder/head forwards.
resource_scope: Only existing lawful public assets on server2203 under named project root; per PLAN two GPUs, per-worker resource bounds, no old test/DTU or new dataset.
claim_limits: No new holdout or external confirmation
No statistically significant, equivalence or novelty claim from three seed means
